summary: Iteration 10: Frontend testing for redesigned Family Carousel and In Loving Memory sections. All 10 test cases PASSED. Family Carousel has 21 images with 3-second auto-scroll, counter showing X/21, desktop buttons alongside slider, mobile buttons below slider, pause on hover working. In Loving Memory has hierarchical grid layout with 2 larger images on top row (Durga Baisa, Alka Jiji) and 2 smaller images on bottom row (Ram Swaroop ji, Shanta Devi ji). Golden door entry navigation works correctly. No console errors.
passed_tests: Family Carousel: has 21 images (counter shows X / 21)
Family Carousel: auto-scrolls every 3 seconds (verified slide changed from 3 to 5 in 4 seconds)
Family Carousel Desktop: prev/next buttons visible alongside (outside) the slider
Family Carousel Desktop: clicking next advances slide correctly
Family Carousel Desktop: clicking prev goes back correctly
Family Carousel: pause on hover working (slide did NOT change during 4s hover)
Family Carousel: auto-scroll resumes after mouse leaves slider area
Family Carousel Mobile (390px): prev/next buttons appear below the slider
Family Carousel Mobile: desktop buttons correctly hidden on mobile viewport
Family Carousel Mobile: mobile buttons work correctly
In Loving Memory: hierarchical layout - top row has 2 larger images (204x204 desktop)
In Loving Memory: bottom row has 2 smaller images (140x140 desktop)
In Loving Memory: all 4 elder images render correctly
In Loving Memory: names displayed below images (Durga Baisa, Alka Jiji, Ram Swaroop ji, Shanta Devi ji)
In Loving Memory Mobile: maintains hierarchy (top 140px, bottom 108px)
Navigation: golden door entry works properly
Overall page: both sections render without console errors
